reason: This text is the preparation narrative for the giving of the Law at Mount Sinai (Exodus 19). It consists entirely of divine instructions from God to Moses about sanctifying the people, setting boundaries around the mountain, and warnings against improper access to the holy place. There is no expression of complaint, murmuring, or dissatisfaction by the Hebrew people against their leaders (Moses, Aaron, or the elders). The tone is entirely one of preparation and obedience to divine instruction.
